{{Ophiuchus}}
Ophiuchus 1 is the 337th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 1st day of Ophiuchus, and it is a Monday. It corresponds to ISO week 49, weekday 1.

Its informal Japanese name is 13宮1日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 337|Chapter 337]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152356}}.

[[Category:Days with weekday Monday]]
[[Category:Days 1 of the Gaian calendar]]
[[Category:Days of Ophiuchus]]
